0022600042.text: The Clippers (2-8, 2-3 at home, 0-5 on the road) host the Thunder (8-3, 5-0 at home, 3-3 on the road) as LA sits 13th in the West and 4th in the Pacific, 7 games back, after a loss in its last outing, while Oklahoma City is 6th in the West and 2nd in the Northwest after a loss of its own. Clippers players Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery) are out, and Cam Christie is day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision, while Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (shoulder surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture) and Thomas Sorber (knee). The Clippers trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 108-101 loss in Oklahoma City on October 25, and they were swept 0-3 by the Thunder in 2025-26.
